events.verdict: Davis (LAL) contests Cunningham's (DET) jump shot and the contact after the release, and follow-through, is marginal.
Harris (DET) moves into James (LAL) and initiates body contact that affects his SQBR during the driving shot attempt.
Cunningham (DET) establishes himself in Reaves' (LAL) path and absorbs the contact as the two come together during the pick.
Cunningham (DET) briefly places his hand to James' (LAL) chest during his drive in transition and the contact is marginal.
Duren (DET) jumps vertically and grazes Christie's (LAL) arm before making clean contact with the ball.
Davis (LAL) establishes himself in Cunningham's (DET) path and marginal body contact occurs as Cunningham moves over the pick.
Duren (DET) grazes James' (LAL) head during his driving shot attempt and the contact is marginal.
Christie (LAL) moves alongside Cunningham (DET) and absorbs the contact as they come together at the end of his drive.
Cunningham (DET) maintains a forearm against James' (LAL) side and immediately slides his hand off his arm during his drive to the basket.

Replay review of the foul called on Harris (DET) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed successful. Harris makes clean contact with the ball contesting Davis's (LAL) driving shot attempt and although Cunningham (DET) reaches in, Davis initiates the marginal contact by extending his leg into him. Since Duren imminently possesses the ball at the point of interruption, Detroit is given possession when play resumes.
Harris (DET) and Davis (LAL) briefly engage and disengage during the rebound.
Davis (LAL) establishes himself in a screening position with his arm slightly extended and the contact with Cunningham (DET) is marginal.
